description: The full transcript of one video or local media file, with a header (title, channel, URL, duration, how the transcript was made, chapters). With timestamps (the default) every line starts with [m:ss] so you can cite moments. Uses creator captions, then platform auto-captions, then speech-to-text. Cost: speech is about 12k tokens per hour of video. For videos longer than about 20 minutes, call get_outline first and read only the sections you need with get_section, or set maxTokens to receive the transcript in pages (each page ends with a cursor for the next one). Formats: text (Plain transcript text. With timestamps, one "[m:ss] line" per caption.); json (The full VideoContext as JSON: metadata, chapters, timed segments, and how it was produced.); markdown (Markdown transcript: title and metadata, chapters as headings, paragraphs prefixed with timestamp links. Options: linkTimestamps, includeComments, includeVisual.); srt (SubRip (.srt) captions: at most 2 lines of 42 characters per cue, no overlaps, for players and editors.); vtt (WebVTT (.vtt) captions for the HTML <track> element, with speaker voice tags when known.); pack (Context pack: one Markdown file for one or many videos, written for an AI model to read, with citation instructions. Options: maxTokens, includeComments, includeVisual, linkTimestamps.); ass (Advanced SubStation Alpha (.ass) subtitles with a readable default style, for mpv, VLC, ffmpeg burn-in and Aegisub. Bilingual subtitles show the second language in a smaller style.); ttml (TTML / IMSC (.ttml) timed text XML for broadcast, streaming packagers and players that read TTML or DFXP.); sbv (YouTube SubViewer (.sbv) captions, the format YouTube Studio imports and exports.); lrc (LRC (.lrc) timed lyrics, one [mm:ss.xx] line per cue, for music players and karaoke apps.); csv (CSV (.csv) with one row per segment: start,end,speaker,text in seconds, plus secondary_text for bilingual output. For spreadsheets and data tools.)

cursor.description: Continuation cursor from a previous partial result (like "seg:412"). Use the same other arguments

language.description: Preferred transcript language (BCP-47, e.g. en, de). Default: the spoken language

maxTokens.description: Largest result to return, in estimated tokens. Longer transcripts come back in pages with a continuation cursor

mode.description: Transcript strategy: auto (captions, then speech-to-text), captions only, stt (always transcribe), video (multimodal model). Default: auto

timestamps.description: Prefix lines with [m:ss] timestamps. Default: true

url.description: Video URL (YouTube and more), a YouTube video id, or a local media file path

name: get_transcript
title: Get video transcript
